tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Extract timed subtitle segments (offset_ms, duration_ms) and complete plain-text transcript for any YouTube video or Short. Supports auto-generated and manual caption tracks in all languages.

tools.name: youtube_video_info
tools.description: Fetch full YouTube video metadata including title, description, viewCount, likeCount, duration_seconds, upload_date, tags, chapters, keywords, and channel details.

tools.name: youtube_comments
tools.description: Extract top or newest video comments with author channel info, upvote count, reply count, published time, and continuation token for pagination.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos, Shorts, channels, or playlists by query string with filters for type, duration, upload date, and sort order.

tools.name: youtube_channel
tools.description: Resolve any YouTube channel handle (@handle), channel ID (UC...), or vanity URL to get subscriber count, video count, bio, avatar, and banner.

tools.name: youtube_channel_videos
tools.description: List a YouTube channel's uploaded videos feed sorted by newest, popular, or oldest.

tools.name: youtube_channel_shorts
tools.description: List a YouTube channel's uploaded Shorts feed sorted by newest or popular.

tools.name: youtube_trending
tools.description: Fetch currently trending YouTube videos by country code and category.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: youtube_channel, youtube_channel_videos, youtube_channel_shorts · Private data: youtube_comments · Public sink: youtube_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: youtube_channel, youtube_channel_videos, youtube_channel_shorts · Private data: youtube_comments · Public sink: youtube_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
